latest_release.body:
## 下载哪个 / Which file to download

- **`Mika-v0.1.39-arm64.apk`**：近几年的安卓手机基本都选这个，更小。
- **`Mika-v0.1.39.apk`**：通用包，所有手机都能装。不确定就选它。
- 两个包功能完全一样，可以互相覆盖安装；App 里「关于 › 检查更新」会自动选合适的那个。

- **`Mika-v0.1.39-arm64.apk`**: for almost any recent Android phone — smaller.
- **`Mika-v0.1.39.apk`**: universal, installs on every phone. Pick this if unsure.
- Both are identical in features and can be installed over each other; About › Check for updates picks the right one automatically.

## 变化 / What's new

- **点击与输入更可靠**：点击上报后画面无变化时自动改走另一条通道补点（无障碍点击与触摸互备）；自绘输入框增加原生粘贴回退；远程解锁在生物识别优先页会回退点击「使用密码」，凭据框只按已有残留清空；十进制键盘按编辑而非删除处理。
- **推荐任务与草稿**：首页推荐任务可在设置中增删改，点击不会误覆盖已输入内容（有内容时先确认）；后台分享进入当前会话，替换草稿前也会确认。
- **Token 用量页显示服务商余额与额度**，并为任务和服务商设置 Token 预算。
- **电脑端**：任务台支持后台提醒并可点击回到对应轮次；新增只读 Web 控制台；监听端口可自定义；新增用户终端（PTY + xterm.js）。
- **浏览器增强**：多标签、历史、页内查找、清除数据、视频全屏、下载管理与书签、文件上传和网页权限询问；搜索可按服务商选择（You.com / Jina / Exa / SearXNG）并支持自定义搜索引擎。
- **语音输入**：新增 Fun-ASR 实时语音（自建服务端 / 百炼），按住说话可上滑直接发送。
- **飞书连接器**：新增飞书通道（二维码接入），并修复排队回复、撤权等时序问题。
- **更多**：跨会话文件库与重新问恢复附件、自动更新下载绑定 Wi-Fi、微信任务独立唤醒/解锁授权、教 Mika 采集成技能、路线分享地基、通知诊断命令、新增波斯语、修复繁体中文、记忆改删授权校验与教学脱敏等。

- **More reliable taps and typing**: a click that reports success but changes nothing now retries through the other channel (accessibility click ↔ touch); self-drawn editors gain a native Paste fallback; remote unlock taps "Use password" on biometric-first pages and clears only existing residual input; the decimal keypad is treated as editing, not deleting.
- **Recommended tasks and drafts**: home recommended tasks are now editable in Settings and never overwrite what you typed (it asks first); background shares land in the current conversation and confirm before replacing a draft.
- **Provider balance and quotas** on the Token usage page, plus per-task and per-provider token budgets.
- **Computer side**: the task desk supports background reminders with click-to-jump; a read-only web console; a customizable listening port; and a user terminal (PTY + xterm.js).
- **Browser upgrades**: tabs, history, in-page search, clear-data, fullscreen video, downloads, bookmarks, file upload with permission prompts; search by provider (You.com / Jina / Exa / SearXNG) and custom search engines.
- **Voice input**: Fun-ASR real-time speech (self-hosted / Bailian), and hold-to-talk swipe-up to send.
- **Feishu connector**: a new Feishu channel (QR onboarding) with queueing and revocation timing fixes.
- **More**: cross-session file library and restore attachments on re-ask, Wi-Fi-only auto-update downloads, per-WeChat-task wake/unlock authorization, Teach-Mika skill capture, path-sharing foundation, notification diagnostics, Persian, Traditional Chinese fixes, memory authorization checks and teaching redaction.

从旧版本直接覆盖安装即可，对话和设置都保留。Install over the previous version; your chats and settings are kept.

detail.readme:
# Mika **An AI assistant on your phone: say what you need, and it works your apps and the web until it's done.** It works on a hidden background screen, so you can keep using your phone.

English · [简体中文](docs/readme/README.zh-CN.md) · [繁體中文](docs/readme/README.zh-Hant.md) · [日本語](docs/readme/README.ja.md) · [한국어](docs/readme/README.ko.md) · [Español](docs/readme/README.es.md)
"Send a message to File Transfer": Mika's chat on the left, each step on its background screen on the right (4× speed; chat list blurred)
## Get things done with one sentence

"What did the group talk about today?"
Scrolls through the chat in the background, then sums it up
"A charger under $30, rated 4.5 stars or more"
Adds the pick to the cart and stops before checkout
"What has this creator posted lately?"
Opens the app, reads post by post, then sums it up
More demos

Greets recruiters for 3 jobs on a job site
Finds the cheapest nonstop from San Francisco to New York
Reads out the top 5 stories on a news site

Finds jobs and greets recruiters
Watches ads to unlock music perks
Orders takeout with stacked discounts, asks before paying
Several demos use apps popular in China: WeChat is the main messaging app there, and Xiaohongshu (RED) is a lifestyle and social platform. Mika isn't tied to them; it works with any app or website on your phone. ## Why Mika | | | |---|---| | 📱 **Leaves your screen alone** | Opens apps, taps, types and scrolls on a separate background screen while you use your phone as usual; tap the small live view whenever you want to watch | | 🧩 **Works with any app** | Looks at the screen and finds buttons the way a person does: no app APIs, no per-app integration | | 🌐 **Call it from any web page** | In the built-in browser, say what you want on the page you're reading and it works right there; touch the page and it stops | | 🧠 **Gets better with use** | Remembers the preferences you tell it, and turns tasks it finishes into skills so next time is faster and steadier | | 🔒 **Your data stays on your phone** | There is no Mika server; use your own model API key, or sign in with a ChatGPT, xAI or OpenRouter account | | 🆓 **Open source and free** | Apache-2.0, all code public | ## Get started in three steps 1. **Install**: download the APK from [Releases](https://github.com/wangzan101/Mika/releases/latest). 2. **Connect a model**: in Settings › Model, pick a provider and enter an API key, or just sign in with an account ([models and sign-in](docs/models.en.md)). 3. **To operate phone apps**: follow the "Set up phone control" wizard in Settings and pair wireless debugging on the phone once ([setup guide](docs/setup-guide.en.md)). Skip this if you only want chat, web and files. Then try saying: "Set alarms for 9:40 and 10:00 tomorrow morning" or "Check the weather at 8 every morning and tell me only if it will rain". > 💡 Have a computer handy? Send this to the AI agent on it and it will set everything up for you:
> `Follow https://github.com/wangzan101/Mika/blob/main/docs/install-with-agent.en.md to install Mika on the Android phone connected over USB.` ## What it can do | | | |---|---| | **Operate apps** | Reads long lists and chat histories, taps and types, shares text into apps; hands logins, verification codes and payments to you | | **Browse the web** | A built-in desktop-class browser that keeps you signed in, reads pages, downloads and uploads; paces itself and hands block pages to you | | **Your current screen** | Double-tap the floating capsule to send the screen you're looking at: "how should I reply?", "note this down" | | **Schedules and conditions** | "Remind me at 9 tomorrow", "do this every Friday"; runs on time in the original conversation | | **Jump in or stop anytime** | Keep talking while a task runs to add or correct things (long-press to withdraw or edit one Mika hasn't picked up yet); after a stop it reports where it got to, and "continue" picks up from there | | **Hold to talk** | Hold the chat input to speak and edit the words before sending; long-press the floating capsule to speak and release to send. Uses the phone’s built-in speech recognition, or a provider’s speech model if it has none | | **Files and computing** | A Linux sandbox per conversation runs Python, Node and shell on the files you send (arm64) | | **From your computer** | AI tools on your computer can hand Mika tasks through CLI + Skill or MCP ([use Mika from a computer](docs/computer.en.md)) | By default Mika runs in **Ask mode**: it checks with you only before spending money (placing orders, paying) and just does everything else. You can switch to **Autonomous mode** instead. See [Ask and Autonomous](docs/modes.en.md). For how each of these works and the finer details, see [features in detail](docs/features.en.md).
Apps and websites with built-in usage knowledge (anything not listed still works) The names are shown as they appear in the knowledge files. | Category | Built in | |---|---| | **Apps** | 支付宝, Android 设置, 百家号, 哔哩哔哩, BOSS直聘, Chrome, 得到, 抖音, 飞书, Gmail, 京东, 即刻, 快手, 领英, 美团, 拼多多, QQ邮箱, 淘宝, Telegram, 今日头条, Uber, Uber Eats, 微信, 微博, WhatsApp, X, 闲鱼, 小红书, 知乎 | | **Websites** | Amazon, 哔哩哔哩, Google Calendar, 豆瓣, 抖音, GitHub, Instagram, Gmail, Google Maps, Telegram, 百度贴吧, 微博, 搜狗微信, WhatsApp, 小红书, 小宇宙, YouTube, 知乎, BOSS直聘 | | **How-to skills** | 改 Mika 自己的设置, 把内容整理成文字, 处理 PDF 文档, 查清一件事, 消息与邮件, 写技能 |
Supported model providers Presets for DeepSeek, 通义千问, Kimi, 智谱, 智谱 Coding Plan, 硅基流动, 火山方舟, MiniMax, 阶跃星辰, 腾讯混元, 百度千帆, OpenRouter, Requesty, OpenCode Go, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI, xAI, Mistral, Groq, Ollama, LM Studio and more; for any other provider pick Custom (自定义), which takes any OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic, Gemini or OpenAI Responses endpoint. You can also skip the key and sign in with a ChatGPT (Plus / Pro), xAI / Grok or OpenRouter account. Steps for adding a model, and what to know about each sign-in, are in [models and sign-in](docs/models.en.md).
## Which phones | | Requirement | |---|---| | Chat, web, files | Android 11 or later | | Operating phone apps | Android 12 or later; **Android 14+ recommended** (the background screen has its own focus, so it doesn't get in the way of your typing on the main screen) | | Linux sandbox | arm64 devices | Not sure your phone is up to it? Run Settings › Recovery & repair › **Compatibility self-check**: 12 checks in about a minute, and you can [send us the results](https://github.com/wangzan101/Mika/issues/new?template=device-report.yml) in one tap. ## Privacy & safety - **There is no Mika server**: what you say and what's on your screen go only to the model provider you set up. - API keys and memories are stored encrypted on the phone; conversations and run records stay on the device; update checks only contact GitHub. - Operating third-party apps and websites automatically may break their terms of service, so use your own judgment. For anything important, use Ask mode and check the results. See the [disclaimer](docs/disclaimer.en.md).
FAQ **Wireless debugging turned itself off?** Android turns it off when you change Wi-Fi or restart. With your permission, Mika turns it back on by itself; if it still can't connect, go back to "Set up phone control" and pair again. **Can't find wireless debugging on my phone?** Some phone systems leave it out. You can start the phone helper from a computer over USB instead; see the [setup guide](docs/setup-guide.en.md). **Some screens can't be read or captured?** Pages like payments and password entry block screenshots, so Mika asks you to take over there. **Can I use a model running on my own computer?** Yes: pick "Custom" as the provider and enter its address on your local network. **Is the app in English?** Yes. The app UI comes in English, Arabic, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian and Indonesian, follows your system language, and can be switched in Settings › Language. The built-in app and website knowledge is written in Chinese, but that doesn't limit you: the model reads it fine, and you can talk to Mika in English. **Where do updates come from?** Only from this repository's [Releases](https://github.com/wangzan101/Mika/releases); you can also upgrade in the app from About › Check for updates. More answers are in the [FAQ](docs/faq.en.md).
## Community & contributing - **Docs**: all docs and a suggested reading order are in the [docs index](docs/README.en.md) - **Community**: join the [X group chat](https://x.com/i/chat/group_join/g2116926829198246025/48B52j5svL); to reach the author on WeChat, scan the QR code in the app under About › Contact the author (mention Mika in your request) - **Follow the author**: X [@wangzan101](https://x.com/wangzan101) - **Report a problem**: [open an issue](https://github.com/wangzan101/Mika/issues/new/choose); About › Send feedback in the app can attach diagnostics - **Contribute**: add usage knowledge for an app or website (plain text, no code needed), or contribute code; see the [contributing guide](.github/CONTRIBUTING.md) ## Star History ## Contributors Thanks to everyone who has helped build Mika: ## License [Apache-2.0](LICENSE) · [NOTICE](NOTICE) · [Third-party components](licenses/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)
